text:
incidents-bot: STATUS ALERT: We are investigating elevated fallback routing to model-compat variants in eu-west1 resulting in higher latency for some hosted API requests. Live status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2098765432-eu-routing-backpressure

zara-sre: Observed a sudden increase in per-route queue lengths on the routing table; routing controller is triggering aggressive fallback to smaller model variants which increases tail latency ~120ms for affected routes. Spike started at 2098765400.

tom-routing: Root cause appears to be a misconfigured soft-concurrency cap in the routing controller (recent default lowered from 256->64). Reverting the parameter now. Canary revert on eu-west1-router-2. ETA ~6m. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/routing/pulls/527

anya-support: Draft customer note pinned in #support-ops: "Were seeing intermittent higher latency due to temporary model fallback during routing controller backpressure. Were reverting a config change and expect service to return to normal shortly. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2098765432-eu-routing-backpressure" Please review.

claire-product: Add note that affected endpoints include generation and chat endpoints for models in eu-west1 only. We'll include that in the customer update.

zara-sre: Mitigations executed:
- 2098765445: increased temporary concurrency cap for routing controller
- 2098765460: canary revert started on router-2
- 2098765500: started draining fallback queues and cancelling stale inflight reroutes

tom-routing: Canary revert success on eu-west1-router-2 at 2098765710; fallback rate down ~85% on canary traffic. Rolling revert to remaining routers in 2 waves.

ops-automation-bot: Runbook step "routing-backpressure" invoked and pagers notified. Link: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/routing-backpressure

anya-support: Customer note posted to status page at 2098765750. Support queue may see latency inquiries; routing doc pinned in #support-ops.

zara-sre: Current ETA to full restoration ~20-30m. If you see persistent fallbacks after 2098766099, collect request-id+route and escalate to on-call. Postmortem to follow.

incidents-bot: Update published. Next automated update in 15m or on significant change. :rotating_light:
